docs: Layout-aware document ingestion (PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS, rich-text, Spotlight-indexable formats) via a Python sidecar provisioned through uv. Governed provider: install/health are probed, not assumed, and failure follows a declared degradation chain rather than crashing ingest.

installProbe.description: Presence of <runtimeDir>/.venv/bin/python plus a .install-marker.json recording the installed docling version. Absence of either is treated as not-installed.

healthCheck.description: Runs the venv-installed `docling` console script directly (not `uv run`, which expects a pyproject-based project rather than a bare venv). A non-zero exit, timeout, or missing venv is unhealthy; stdout carries the docling/docling-core/docling-parse version lines.

chain.description: Layout-aware extraction (tables, OCR, all formats) via the local Python sidecar.
unpdf (PDF) or mammoth (DOCX) — pure-JS, lower fidelity, no OCR, no XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS support.
No extractor available for this format; ingest fails loud with an actionable install hint.
